tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolve a library name to a Context7-compatible library id. Same operation as the Context7 MCP tool.

input.query: string, required. The user question, used to rank matches.
input.libraryName: string, required. Library name such as react or next.js.

tools.name: query-docs
tools.description: Fetch documentation for one library id and one question. Same operation as the Context7 MCP tool.

input.libraryId: string, required. Context7 id such as /vercel/next.js.
input.query: string, required. One topic, not a bundle of topics.
input.language: string, optional. Prefer examples in this language.

capabilities.title: Playwright CLI
capabilities.installHint: npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest — Just Do It does not run the browser.

tools.name: playwright-cli
tools.description: User-local CLI. Read playwright-cli --help in that environment. This server does not spawn it.
